Why should red wine not have equal rights?

Red wine isn’t a person or sentient being, so it doesn’t have moral or legal rights in the way humans do. It can still be treated fairly in practical terms—for example, regulations shouldn’t arbitrarily discriminate against red wine compared with other alcoholic beverages—but limits on its sale or use may be justified for public-health and safety reasons.
